title.narrative: Support corporate governance reform of Colombia's National Infrastructure Agency in order to improve Colombian capacity to deliver infrastructure projects that enable inclusive economic growth

description.narrative: Support the creation of corporate governance standards and capabilities at Colombia's National Infrastructure Agency in line with UK best practice. Improved infrastructure is key to sustainable economic growth and will reduce poverty in Colombia. Our work will make large Colombian infrastructure projects more attractive to international finance and business (including from UK), and make their successful delivery more likely, which would increase the potential for sustainable economic growth.
